result.title: Linear Probes Can Guide: Training-Free Control of Representation Generators
result.summary: Representation-space generative models, such as Representation Autoencoders (RAEs), leverage pretrained vision foundation models (VFMs) primarily to accelerate training and improve sample fidelity. Yet VFMs are more than reconstruction tokenizers, as they feature rich representation spaces that are highly organized and linearly readable. We observe that this removes a key obstacle of post-hoc guidance: by linearity of expectation, a clean probe applied to an ideal denoiser's prediction yields the exact posterior mean of the probe scores at any noise level. This regime, which we call Semantic Mean-Space, turns semantic guidance into a Bayesian linear inverse problem, bypassing the need for training-time conditioning. With this foundation, we propose LiSM, a unified framework for Linear Guidance in Semantic Mean-Space. To validate the framework, we developed and adapted different solvers, and characterized them based on how they estimate probe-space uncertainty and propagate the correction through the representation. In addition, we propose Fit-Path, a solver designed to achieve strong global and local control. Our results in four control setups (class, attributes, foreground, and keypoints) show that LiSM methods, and Fit-Path in particular, provide effective, lightweight control across global and local tasks, outperforming noise-aware and pixel-space guidance.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究表示空间生成模型（如 RAE）的免训练语义引导：利用预训练视觉基础模型表示空间的线性可读性，把干净线性探针作用于去噪预测，在所称「语义均值空间」中把引导化为贝叶斯线性逆问题，提出统一的 LiSM 框架及 Fit-Path 求解器，并在类别、属性、前景与关键点四类控制任务上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 可核查的线索是把线性探针作为表示空间的读出接口，并按噪声水平估计不确定性、传播修正——这或可类比用于监测或定向干预 VLM 的 latent 推理状态；但研究对象是扩散式图像生成而非多模态推理，迁移仅是推测。
